items: Try the wallpaper in your browser: the real app draws it, live in a phone on this site, with nothing to install.
Pick any of the 19 styles and its layouts, change its settings, and tap the big gauge to switch its mode.
GPS speed can show how fast you're going, from your browser's location, once you allow it.
Speedometer Live Wallpaper 2.0 is out on Google Play, rebuilt from the 2016 original: your home screen as a car dashboard.
The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed: tap it, or use the new Quick Settings tile, to switch.
In GPS mode a red mark keeps the top speed of your drive.
Browse the designs with live previews and buy more through Google Play. The Future design shows your music, missed calls and messages.
Update from inside the app as soon as a new version is out.
